anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gentle convex arc with a large radius forming a smooth transition from the blowhole region to the snout.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a thick base and a tapered distal point, extending roughly 15% of the visible head length.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle approximately 150 degrees at the junction where the melon slope meets the rostrum's dorsal surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent pectoral fin visible in the ventral-lateral quadrant, characterized by a broad base and a slightly falcate trailing edge.
